meta.description: One credit is one project. No subscription. Your first project is free and complete; after that a credit is 9.99 € at founder price, and everything inside a project — edits and exports — is unlimited forever.

head.title: One credit is one project.
head.lede: No subscription, no seats, nothing to cancel. A credit is spent once — the moment you create a project — and that project is yours to work on forever.

flow.title: Spent once. Then everything is free.

steps.title: You create a project
steps.body: Name it, set its length or drop in the track. This is the only moment a credit is used.

steps.title: You work on it
steps.body: Sections, emotional curve, mood board, shots, golden hour, the track when it finally arrives. For as long as you want.

steps.title: You export, and export again
steps.body: EDL for Resolve and Premiere, shooting PDF. Re-export after every change, as many times as the shoot needs.

freeItems: The whole app, not a trial
Mood board, shot cards, golden hour
founderItems: One full project, start to shoot

launch.title: Pricing arrives with the launch.
launch.lede: Your first project is free and complete, and after that each project is one credit. The figures — the single credit and the packs of 3, 5 and 10 — are published on launch day, and purchases open then too.

packs.title:
One credit, one project.
Buy them in packs and each costs less.
packs.lede: The rule never changes: a credit is spent once, when you create a project, and everything inside that project — edits and exports — is unlimited and free, forever. Packs just lower what each project costs you.
packs.notice: Credits never expire and purchases open with launch — packs are shown here so you know what a project will cost you. Savings are compared against buying single credits at 19.99 €; packs have never been sold at a different price. Payments are processed by Stripe, which appears as the seller on your statement.

cards.title: Exporting
cards.body: EDL and shooting PDF, as many times as you like, for every version of the plan.

cards.title: Editing, forever
cards.body: Open a project from two years ago and keep working. There's nothing to renew.

cards.title: Relocating the same file
cards.body: Moved the MP3 to another drive? Point PreFrame at it again. Same file, no charge.

cards.title: Adding the track later
cards.body: Start from a curve with no music and attach the master when it lands. Same project, same credit.

items.q: What if the project gets cancelled halfway?
a: The project stays in your account and so does everything in it. Credits are spent on creating a project, not on finishing one — if the video dies, the plan is still yours to reuse or strip for parts.
Because you don't plan a video every month. Paying rent on a tool you open in bursts is the reason most people quit these apps. You pay for the piece you're making.

items.q: Can I buy several credits at once?
a: Yes — credits will come in packs of 3, 5 and 10, and the bigger the pack the less each project costs. Purchases open with launch.
Yes, one account holds your credits, your projects and your shot library. Your audio and reference images stay on your machine either way.
Stripe. They're the seller of record for PreFrame, so your statement shows Stripe and they handle the tax side. Refunds and receipts go through them too.
